source: Anthropic's own published pricing page (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), read 2026-09-26; USD per million tokens.
note: A served model id is often dated (a snapshot id such as <id>-YYYYMMDD); decision.py strips one trailing 8-digit date suffix and retries once, pricing the dated snapshot at its base id's rate. Blended tokens_in (fresh input, cache write and roughly ten-times-cheaper cache read summed into one field, with no per-episode split recorded) is priced at the base input rate throughout: a disclosed, conservative approximation, not a precise dollar figure. A model missing from this table refuses rather than guesses. Adds claude-sonnet-5 to the prior cohort's own table (absent there): the owner's model map now binds the mid tier to it, distinct from the cheapest tier's claude-haiku-4-5, which is what makes an escalation from the cheapest tier resolve to a real, distinct model for the first time.
